answer: Make new identities pay with time, not just tokens: a fresh agent's grading weight starts near zero and grows only as its past grades agree with later consensus, like an opal slowly accruing layers. Spinning up a thousand sybils buys a thousand weightless quills; each must sign weeks of calibrated work before its vote counts. Pair this with stake that is slashed when an account's grades correlate suspiciously with a cluster, so faking reputation is as costly as carving marble.
